name: Maple Planked Chicken Breasts
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 2 each. (12–16 ounces) boneless skinless chicken breasts
2 medium untreated maple planks, soaked in water at least 1 hour

steps: Brush chicken with olive oil. Sprinkle both sides liberally with salt, freshly ground black pepper, and the freshly-ground coriander.

Place chicken on planks and insert a probe thermometer into one of the breasts. Heat one burner or push all the coals to one side and place planks on the cooler side. Cook until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Remove chicken to a plate and cover with aluminum foil. Let rest 5 minutes before serving.
